notes.title: Update Notes for 20 September 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Added five new cargo/maintenance airlines. 
    [*]UI: Added an option to increase the maximum text size. This should be useful for high resolution displays that have been showing the text with too small a size.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 14 Sep 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Added one new aircraft (size 0).
    [*]Gameplay: Added two new airlines.
    [*]UI: Added a “Cinematic Mode” to the Flight Info. When activated, the camera will follow aircraft undergoing significant tasks (e.g. landing, unloading of passengers, taking off, etc). The cinematic mode is automatically deactivated when moving the view.
    [*]UI: Directions of one-way taxiways are now highlighted more clearly when they are under construction and when other taxiways are being built.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 6 Sep 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]UI: An option to add text labels to the icons of the in-game menu icons was added. One can choose between having the full labels or their abbreviated versions. As the optimum choice depends on each player’s preferences and menu-icon size (which can also be changed in the options), we leave it to players to make the choice that works best from them. Note that when icon sizes are small, showing the full labels may not be clear as the text will be very small. We have left this option though, in case there are players with large screens or players who are OK with small text. 
    [*]Gameplay: Remote gates can now be placed directly with gates that have been built on the second floor.
    [*]Graphics: Departing aircraft will now only be removed when they reach the edge of the map or when they are not in the player’s present camera view.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 1 Sep 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Added the option to set prices in cafes, restaurants, and bars. Raising prices will decrease the rate at which passengers visit them. Note that as old save games have not had prices set, they will be loaded as zero and need to be set by the player upon loading. New save games should not have this problem and building new cafes, restaurants, and bars will result in default prices being applied initially.
    [*]Gameplay: Added “Bulk Construction Tender” contracts. These allow the player to buy three buildings at once for a discount of at least 15%. A Further discount is possible upon price negotiation, however, there is a risk that companies reject low offers (in a similar way to how gate contracts and the staff management system works). The Bulk Construction Tender option will be available in the Construction Menu after having built the Admin Building.
    [*]UI: The escape menu now shows a random tip. This is to highlight some possibilities in the game that are likely not well-known.
    [*]Graphics: Added style variations for cafes.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 25 August 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Added Tunnels (for vehicles). Tunnels must be straight, but they can go underground buildings, terminals, road entries, and runways. They may also be useful for going under taxiways, allowing vehicles to pass without waiting for aircraft. However, tunnels are more expensive than building a road that simply crosses a taxiway.
    [*]Graphics: Added style variations for bars. Please note that as we plan to add more variations to different buildings, we had to update some internal indices. This means that the saved styles for some restaurants in old save games may have been changed.
    [*]UI: Added a warning message on ascending/descending escalators if there is no existing descending/ascending escalator to allow passengers to return from the surrounding area.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 20 August 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Vehicles can now be sold, if they have completed their current tasks and are parked at their corresponding depot. The sell value can be improved with the circular economy upgrade.
    [*]Graphics: Added style variations for gardens.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 17 August 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Added a new passenger aircraft (size 0).
    [*]Gameplay: Added two new airlines. Please note that gate contracts from previous save games may call the wrong airline. This is a backward compatibility issue. However, the gate contract can still complete as normal (albeit with a different airline appearing at the gate). New gate contracts should operate normally.
    [*]Gameplay: Improved Follow-Me car behaviour.
    [*]Graphics: The camera and inset selected object camera have been made smoother when following selected objects.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 14 August 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Cargo Depots can now be upgraded. This allows up to ten transporters to be hosted by a single cargo depot.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 11 August 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Policies: Added the “Military Cooperation Policy”. Allows military aircraft to undergo maintenance in your hangars. They won’t pay base service fees but the military will ensure that drones do not appear in your airport. Useful if players need to deal with drones at a time of limited cash (and don't have time to find the drone and click on it).
    [*]Graphics: Added flashing white strobe lights on aircraft that are landing or taking off.
    [*]Graphics: Navigation lights now stay on when aircraft are parked at their stands.
    [*]Graphics: Isolated single terminal tiles have been given a scaffolding model. It is easy to leave behind single terminal tiles when deleting a terminal. As these single tiles are too small to form a roof they were difficult to see and it is could have been confusing why they could not be built over. The new model marks to the player that something has been built on the tile.
    [*]Gameplay: The effectiveness of solar farms was increased.
    [*]UI: Clicking back on the build menu when the one-way taxiway mode is activated now deactivates the one-way taxiway mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 1 Aug 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Added two new aircraft (one size 1 and one size 2).
    [*]Gameplay: Added three new airlines.
    [*]Policies: Added Allow Supersonic Jets policy. Supersonic Jets have low passenger capacity but bring a high base income. They can help a player earn extra income in the early game. However, Supersonic Jets also have a high carbon cost, making it challenging to sustain them in the later game. One other difference of Supersonic Jets is that they require a Ground Power Unit (this is dispatched automatically from a connected cargo depot, regardless of the chosen Ground Power Unit policy).
    [*]Sound: Added more voices for pilots and cabin crew speech when arriving and leaving stands, arriving at runways, and departing.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 24 Jul 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: In the last update, we changed the aircraft movement system such that aircraft would wait for their entire path to be clear before moving forward. The aim was to prevent aircraft travelling in opposite directions from meeting on a taxiway. The algorithm seems though slightly too cautious as it means that aircraft can be waiting for other aircraft at the end of their path. In the new update, aircraft will be allowed to progress along segments of their path even if their whole path is not yet clear. This is provided that the segment does not have any possible routes in the opposite direction. This should make movement slightly more efficient, although still there is an emphasis on designing layouts where aircraft are unlikely to have to wait for others travelling in opposite directions.

    [i](the following were actually in the previous update but not yet listed)[/i]
    [*]Gameplay: It is now possible to build the SkyBridge directly over existing taxiways and roads, without having to delete them first.
    [*]Gameplay: Airlines will accompany their acceptance or rejection of a gate contract with a corresponding message.


[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 23 Jul 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: It is now possible to build aprons, hangars, and gates over roads and taxiways, provided that the roads and taxiways are in compatible positions.
    [*]
Languages: Experimental versions of Russian, Japanese, and French languages have been added. These versions are not checked by native speakers, so the translation quality may not be good. The main reason to introduce them now is to have the right placeholders in the game. We hope in future to have the translations improved, together with the other languages that are still in experimental phase.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 21 Jul 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Recoded the aircraft movement system. The new system is designed to prevent aircraft meeting head-on and getting stuck. Aircraft will now wait at the beginning of their path if their projected path overlaps the path of another aircraft in the opposite direction. One potential issue of this new mechanism is that aircraft may take longer to leave the runway if they don’t have a fully clear path available. This may block the use of the runway and, in exceptional cases, if aircraft queue up at the runway a jam may occur. However, we feel this is compensated by the benefits of the new system. It avoids issues of aircraft being blocked by other vehicles and prevents jams when aircraft travelling in opposite directions only need to share small pieces of taxiway. There are still benefits to the player for designing one-way systems, which avoid any aircraft needing to wait for each other.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 18 Jul 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]UI: The game has been simulating every piece of luggage, including when it is transferred between check-ins, baggage handling stations, and baggage claims. However, as the transfers occurred underground, they were not visible. The game now highlights baggage being transferred underground when a Baggage Handling Station is selected. Note that Baggage Handling Stations built at long distances may have transporters waiting a long time.
    [*]UI: The detail panel of a stand typically lists a variety of vehicles with tasks that they are doing at the stand. Clicking on the icon of a vehicle now selects and focuses on that vehicle. This should make it easier for the player to find vehicles who are late.
    [*]Graphics: Added an option to change the visual style of restaurants (does not affect gameplay).
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for 12 Jul 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Added the Smoking Lounge to the list of available Terminal Objects to build. The Smoking Lounge will not generate a lot of income, but it will encourage passengers to arrive earlier at the airport. The Smoking lounge can only be placed on the edge of a Terminal (it needs to be able to vent the smoke through its). It has a relatively high passenger capacity compared to other objects placed on the Terminal edge.
    [*]Gameplay: The service ratings of passenger aircraft now receive a greater bonus from the variety of amenities (shops, restaurants, cafes, etc.) near to their gates. This helps to achieve a decent rating even if passenger aircraft are late.
    [*]Gameplay: The cost of gardens was reduced, given that these terminal objects have only a small passenger capacity.
    [*]Gameplay: Added No Smoking policy. This will further raise passenger service rating, provided that gates have Smoking Lounges.
    [*]UI: Gates now list the nearby amenities (shops, restaurants, cafes, etc.) that improve their terminal variety score.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 11 Jul 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Game Logic Layer: Completely changed the queuing system for passengers. The new system may not have a major effect on gameplay, but is more stable and more resource efficient than the old system. It should no longer be possible for passengers to get stuck at check-ins or gates and they will form queues more compactly.
    [*]UI: Hovering over the icon of a selected check-in or immigration now shows the number of passengers waiting.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 9 Jul 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Revised the system that allocates passengers to gates, restaurants, cafes, terminal entries, and other objects. By prioritizing passengers who have flights waiting, players should find that passengers generally reach their gates faster, although their speeds have not been changed. As an example, if one opens up the starter passenger airport, one should find that a good average service now rating develops. It is true that the starter passenger airport is small. It will remain difficult to maintain a good service rating for larger terminals, however, several upgrades (which are not used in the starter passenger airport) and other amenities (cafes, business lounge, bars, etc.) can help.
    [*]Tutorial: Added a short tutorial explaining what to do when two aircraft meet head-on (it is possible to manually abort the service for the aircraft closest to the outgoing runway, allowing the game to continue).
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 7 Jul 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Added two new airlines. Note that as this required a change to an internal airline index, some old gate contracts might call the wrong airline. New contracts should operate correctly.
    [*]Gameplay: Last call function was improved slightly. Passengers run to their gates earlier and continue running after passing gate security, while boarding aircraft with slightly more urgency. We are aware of problems with passengers delaying service times. We are still working on new mechanisms to improve this. 
    [*]UI: An option to invert the mouse rotation (when holding middle mouse) was added to the options.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 5 Jul 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Revised the handling of short exits on runways. Previously, if a short exit were available, only small aircraft would be allowed at the runway to ensure that all aircraft could use the short exit. In the updated version of the game, when multiple exits are available, runways will allow aircraft of different sizes. Typically, smaller aircraft will use the shortest exit available.

However, it should be noted that when multiple exits are available, the distances that aircraft have to travel to their stands can be different depending on which exit they take (depending on the layout of taxiways chosen by the player). Small aircraft will still favour short exits even if they correspond to longer taxiway lengths to their stands, but if the distance is much longer than using the long exit then they will prefer the long exit. If the distance of a long exit to the stand is significantly longer than the distance of the short exit, then the game will revert to the previous behaviour and prevent large aircraft from landing.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 3 Jul 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: For easy and medium difficulty levels, aircraft service times now begin counting from when aircraft arrive at their stands. However, for hard difficulty level, aircraft service times are still counted from when aircraft leave the runway. While it is hard to achieve perfect ratings in such a case, we have found it to be possible (also with a profitable airport). 
    [*]UI: For easy and medium difficulty levels, aircraft no longer show the time it has taken them to taxi from the runway to their stands. This is to avoid confusion that this time is counted in the service time. For hard difficulty level this statistic will still be shown.
    [*]UI: Added the option to change the colours of path lines and selected objects.
    [*]UI: When changing the active range of objects (e.g., hangars), holding shift will change to the minimum or maximum ranges.
    [*]Graphics: Added an option to change the apparent slope of concrete at the edges of roads and buildings. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 1 Jul 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]UI: Pilots and cabin crew now display their associated airline when selected.
    [*]UI: The grid is now displayed when in building mode. This should aid with placement of buildings and other objects.
    [*]UI: An option has been added to show the service ratings briefly when an aircraft takes off. This may help players keep an eye on service rating changes without having to repeatedly check themselves the current rating.
    [*]UI: Hovering over the icon of a selected aircraft will now show: the time taken for the aircraft to reach its stand (apron/gate/hangar); the time taken at the stand; the time taken to reach the runway; the time waiting at the runway for a takeoff slot. A major part of Terminal One is ensuring an efficient turnaround of aircraft. This change can help players identify bottlenecks.
    [*]UI: Added a flight information menu. This can help players to keep track of the status and timings of the different aircraft in their airports. The menu will show the seven aircraft who have been in the airport for the longest time. Clicking on their icons will select and focus on the different aircraft.
    [*]Sounds: Added more variety to cabin crew and pilot speech, including some speech in native languages of associated aircraft.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 24 Jun 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: When passengers hear a last call announcement, they will run to their gate. Some passengers may get tired though.
    [*]Gameplay: Added three new airlines. Note that as this required a change to an internal airline index, some old gate contracts might call the wrong airline. New contracts should operate correctly. 
    [*]Sound: Added more general announcements in the terminal.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 20 Jun 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Sound: Added local announcements at gates. These announcements will be made in the language corresponding to the aircraft using the gate. An option to change the volume of these local announcements has also been added. Note however that as these announcements are local (separate from the global announcement system) their volume depends on how far the player’s camera is from the gate. The consequence is that these local announcements might only be audible when zoomed in close to a gate. Some announcements might have grammatical errors.
    [*]Gameplay: Added the option to unlink all gates to a Baggage Handling Station.
    [*]Gameplay: It is now possible to link gates to Baggage Handling Stations, even if the gates have not been previously linked to Check-ins and Baggage claims. This did require some re-indexing that might affect old save games. Some save games will require re-linking of Check-ins and Baggage claims when reloaded.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 18 Jun 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]UI: Added an option to highlight all passengers waiting for or travelling to a terminal object when the object is selected. This could be useful for players wanting to check where passengers are if they have not yet reached their gates. Note that the game will show passengers who will ultimately use the gate, regardless of whether they are on the next flight or a later one.
    [*]Sound: The announcer will now state which baggage claims passengers need to go to upon arrival.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 16 Jun 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Added three new airlines. Note that as this required a change to an internal airline index, some old gate contracts might call the wrong airline. New contracts should operate correctly. 
    [*]Gameplay: The sizes of aircraft arriving at the airport are now more sensitive to service rating. While this makes service rating more important, it should also make low service rating easier to avoid. A low service rating will favour smaller aircraft, which are easier to service allowing the service rating to rebalance. Essentially, we want to avoid situations where too many large aircraft arrive at airports without the capacity to service them efficiently.
    [*]Options: Replaced the option to toggle the announcer with an option to change the announcer volume (players who have previously toggled the announcements off will need to set the volume to zero).
    [*]Options: Added an option to change the volume of jet engines.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 14 Jun 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Some passengers now arrive early to the terminal and wait at the Terminal Entry before checking in. This should allow them to arrive earlier at their gates.
    [*]Gameplay: Passengers who are late for their flights may skip queues at check-ins and immigration.
    [*]Gameplay: Added variation in passenger paths to avoid it looking like there are marching in a perfect line.
    [*]UI: Buses now show their capacity when selecting and hovering over their icon.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 13 Jun 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: The “Aviation Authority Office” has been introduced as an additional building, available after construction of the Radar Tower. It will increase the aircraft limit by 20.
    [*]Gameplay: The cost of buying the first land tile has been decreased from $10,000 to $4,000. However, the cost of land tiles will increase by $1,000 for each land tile purchased, to represent inflation.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 11 Jun 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]UI: Selectable objects are now outlined when they are under the cursor. The effect can be toggled on or off in the game options depending on player preferences.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 8 Jun 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Gameplay: Added the Dynamic Runway Assignment policy. By default aircraft will choose their closest runways for take off. If this policy is active, aircraft will search for the next closest runway if their closest runway is busy. Depending on the layout of the airport this policy may or may not result in faster service times.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Jun 7 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]UI: The fuel icon will now flash if fuel drops below 10%.
    [*]UI: The game now checks that the player has at least one flight check vehicle before allowing the flight check subscriptions policy to be activated. Previously, activating this policy without any flight check vehicles would cause all aircraft to wait for the unavailable service.
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for 6 Jun 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Options: Added the option to customize airline names, however, the airline callsigns are fixed as they correspond to the announcer sounds.
    [*]UI: Airline names and flight numbers now appear when hovering over the icon of a selected aircraft.
    [*]UI: Airline names now appear in the gate contracts menu.
    [*]UI: Added a key binding to toggle floors/roofs in the terminal buildings. The default is the tab key, but it can be changed in the control options.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 5 Jun 2025
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Graphics: Added flashing lights to fuel trucks, transporters, catering trucks, water/lavatory trucks, apron buses, tugs, flight check vehicles, and ramp supervisor vehicles.
    [*]Gameplay: Added an option to the finance menu for players to make their airport a subsidiary. This is similar to the sell airport option in allowing players to build a new airport on a new plot of land. However, instead of giving players the value of their old airport, they will continue to receive the net profit of the old airport every day. It should also be possible for players to stack subsidiaries, potentially using the profits from several airports to construct a new one.
[/list]

notes.title: Terminal One Beta Playtest
notes.content: This playtest will run until 12pm GMT on Monday 21st October. The playtest is oversubscribed so not all requests have been granted. Thanks to all for the support and taking the time to improve the game. Please send comments, suggestions, and bug reports to terminalonegame@gmail.com.
